title: 年会主题是金融创新：但焦点全在讲话，市场等待关键信号
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Now, we are just a few days away from the start of the Jackson Hole economic policy symposium, which I'm told is without a doubt the most important monetary policy conference in the world.
segments.zh: 现在，距离杰克逊霍尔经济政策研讨会开幕仅剩几天，我被告知这无疑是全球最重要的货币政策会议。

segments.en: Yes, the official theme of this year's gathering is a theme. Drumroll, please.
segments.zh: 是的，今年会议的官方主题是……请击鼓。

segments.en: Financial innovation, implications for payments in policy. But that on a cake.
segments.zh: 金融创新对支付和政策的影响。但这只是表面。

segments.en: But what everyone is waiting for is the speech fed sure Kevin Warsh is scheduled to deliver on Friday at 10 o'clock Wall Street time that is 8 o'clock Grand Teton's time.
segments.zh: 但所有人都在等待美联储主席凯文·沃什定于周五华尔街时间上午10点（即大提顿时间上午8点）发表的讲话。

segments.en: Tom Keane will be there. He is back with us before he makes the pilgrimage to the cowboy state.
segments.zh: 汤姆·基恩将前往现场。在他启程前往牛仔州之前，他再次与我们连线。

segments.en: We're also joined this morning by Henrietta Trays, who's the Director of Economic Policy at Veda Partners.
segments.zh: 今天早上我们还邀请到了亨利埃塔·特雷斯，她是Veda Partners的经济政策主管。

segments.en: Tom, let me start with you. You've been to this many years running now.
segments.zh: 汤姆，让我先问你。你已经连续多年参加这个会议了。

segments.en: Way too many. I don't want to say how many.
segments.zh: 太多了，我不想说具体多少年。

segments.en: How highly anticipated is this speech? I think it's a trope. We lean on it.
segments.zh: 这次讲话的受期待程度有多高？我觉得这有点老生常谈，我们常这么说。

segments.en: Other fed sure is going to speak. The world will be listening. In this circumstance, is it different?
segments.zh: 美联储主席将发表讲话，全世界都会倾听。在这种情况下，有什么不同吗？

segments.en: I would say in 25 years, it's been three or four times like this.
segments.zh: 我想说，25年里，这种情况只出现过三四次。

segments.en: Without question, I'll say the summer of 07 right after the forced interdiviation move in LIBOR.
segments.zh: 毫无疑问，我会说2007年夏天，就在LIBOR强制干预之后。

segments.en: That was interesting. I have a clear memory of Stanley Fisher glued to the phone looking out at the Rocky Mountains and there was a real tension, real angst.
segments.zh: 那很有趣。我清楚记得斯坦利·费希尔盯着电话，望着落基山脉，气氛紧张，充满焦虑。

segments.en: It's a different tension this time, but it's a big deal. How do you get what do investors, what do attendants want to hear?
segments.zh: 这次紧张感不同，但事关重大。市场参与者和与会者想听到什么？

segments.en: What makes this a success, especially given everything that's happened in the past week?
segments.zh: 考虑到过去一周发生的一切，怎样才算成功？
